title: Closed spans as half-open intervals
statement: Let $\ell,h\in\mathbb{Z}$ with $\ell\le h$. The closed-span marker for $[\ell,h]$ equals the half-open interval marker starting at $\ell$ with natural-number width $(h-\ell+1)$, where the width is the natural conversion of that integer.
replaced:
For all integers $\ell \le h$, the closed-span marker of $[\ell, h]$ equals the half-
open interval marker starting at $\ell$ of width $h - \ell + 1$.
